about.title: Hi! I'm Mariel
about.lead: And I'll help your brand connect authentically through attractive, fresh and relatable visual content.
about.p1: I'm Mariel! I'm 25 years old, from Puerto Ordaz, Venezuela, and I'm passionate about audiovisual creation. Thanks to my degree in Social Communication at UCAB, I know the ideal tools for effective audiovisual communication, but my creativity and leadership are what bring my videos to life.
about.p2: You'll have a friendly and approachable voice accompanying your product. I'm currently a radio host at FAMA 91.5 FM, part of the Oye network.
about.p3: My collaboration list isn't long yet, but I want to bring my energy and professionalism to your brand in an organic and sincere way through UGC.
